```{r}
library(INLA)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(innovar)
library(gt)
library(ggsci)
library(cowplot)
library(yardstick)

source("./_functions/functions.R")

data("Peru")
```

# Data

```{r}
set.seed(123)

wi_edu<- read.csv("./data/wi_edu_2010_2020.csv") %>%
  mutate(ubigeo = as.character(ubigeo))

distritos<- Peru %>%
  mutate(ubigeo = as.character(ubigeo)) %>%
  filter(dep == "LORETO") %>%
  arrange(ubigeo)

wi_censo_final<- read.csv("./data/wi_censo_final_recat.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    ubigeo = as.character(ubigeo),
    direct_low = hv270_recat - 1.96*se,
    direct_upp = hv270_recat + 1.96*se
  ) %>%
  select(year,ubigeo,hv270_recat,direct_low,direct_upp) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hv270_recat))

censo_pca<- read.csv("./data/censo_2017/censo_2017_pca_20.csv") %>%
  mutate(ubigeo = as.character(ubigeo))
```

```{r}
district_levels<- sort(unique(distritos$ubigeo))
year_levels<- 2010:2020
prov_levels<- sort(unique(substr(district_levels, 1, 4)))

pca_scores<- censo_pca %>% select(ubigeo, pc1, pc2)

cluster_wi<- wi_edu %>%
  filter(!is.na(hv270_recat), !is.na(long), !is.na(lat)) %>%
  group_by(hv001, ubigeo, year, long, lat) %>%
  summarise(p_w = weighted.mean(hv270_recat, hv005),
            n_eff = sum(hv005)^2 / sum(hv005^2),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    n = round(n_eff),
    y = round(p_w * n),
    ubigeo = as.character(ubigeo),
    id.sp = match(ubigeo, district_levels),
    id.time = match(year, year_levels),
    ubigeo_prov = substr(ubigeo, 1, 4),
    id.prov = match(ubigeo_prov, prov_levels)
  )
```

```{r}
pred_grid<- expand.grid(
  ubigeo = district_levels,
  year = year_levels,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    id.sp = match(ubigeo, district_levels),
    id.time = match(year, year_levels)
  )

pred_grid_wi<- pred_grid %>%
  mutate(
    ubigeo_prov = substr(ubigeo, 1, 4),
    id.prov = match(ubigeo_prov, prov_levels)
  )

nb<- poly2nb(distritos, row.names = distritos$ubigeo)
nb2INLA("./data/loreto_adj.graph", nb)
inla_graph<- inla.read.graph("./data/loreto_adj.graph")

pc_prec<- list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01)))
pc_bym2<- list(
  phi = list(prior = "pc", param = c(0.5, 2/3)),
  prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01))
)

prior_bb_rho<- list(hyper = list(rho = list(prior = "gaussian", param = c(0, 0.4))))

st_group<- list(model = "ar1",
                hyper = list(rho = list(prior = "pc.cor1", param = c(0.7, 0.7))))

ctrl_inla_wi<- list(int.strategy = "ccd", control.vb = list(enable = FALSE))
```

```{r}
cluster_wi_pca<- cluster_wi %>% left_join(pca_scores, by = "ubigeo")
pred_grid_pca<- pred_grid_wi %>% left_join(pca_scores, by = "ubigeo")

inla_data_wi<- bind_rows(
  cluster_wi_pca %>% select(ubigeo, year, id.sp, id.prov, id.time, y, n, pc1, pc2),
  pred_grid_pca %>% mutate(y = NA, n = NA_integer_) %>%
    select(ubigeo, year, id.sp, id.prov, id.time, y, n, pc1, pc2)
) %>% mutate(id.sp2 = id.sp)

n_obs_wi<- nrow(cluster_wi_pca)
pred_idx_wi<- (n_obs_wi + 1):nrow(inla_data_wi)
```

# Fit INLA

```{r}
formula_bb_m1<- y ~ 1 +
  f(id.sp, model = "bym2", graph = inla_graph,
    scale.model = TRUE, hyper = pc_bym2) +
  f(id.time, model = "rw2", scale.model = TRUE, hyper = pc_prec) +
  f(id.sp2, model = "besag", graph = inla_graph, scale.model = TRUE,
    group = id.time, control.group = st_group, hyper = pc_prec)

formula_bb_m2<- y ~ 1 +
  f(id.sp, model = "bym2", graph = inla_graph,
    scale.model = TRUE, hyper = pc_bym2) +
  f(id.prov, model = "iid",
    hyper = list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01)))) +
  f(id.time, model = "rw2", scale.model = TRUE, hyper = pc_prec) +
  f(id.sp2, model = "besag", graph = inla_graph, scale.model = TRUE,
    group = id.time, control.group = st_group, hyper = pc_prec)

formula_bb_m3<- y ~ 1 + pc1 +
  f(id.sp, model = "bym2", graph = inla_graph,
    scale.model = TRUE, hyper = pc_bym2) +
  f(id.time, model = "rw2", scale.model = TRUE, hyper = pc_prec) +
  f(id.sp2, model = "besag", graph = inla_graph, scale.model = TRUE,
    group = id.time, control.group = st_group, hyper = pc_prec)

formula_bb_m4<- y ~ 1 + pc1 + pc2 +
  f(id.sp, model = "bym2", graph = inla_graph,
    scale.model = TRUE, hyper = pc_bym2) +
  f(id.time, model = "rw2", scale.model = TRUE, hyper = pc_prec) +
  f(id.sp2, model = "besag", graph = inla_graph, scale.model = TRUE,
    group = id.time, control.group = st_group, hyper = pc_prec)
```

## M1: BetaBin + BYM2 + RW2 + Besag×AR1

```{r}
fit_bb_m1<- inla(
  formula_bb_m1,
  family = "betabinomial",
  Ntrials = inla_data_wi$n,
  data = inla_data_wi,
  control.family = prior_bb_rho,
  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, link = 1),
  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE, config = TRUE),
  control.inla = ctrl_inla_wi,
  verbose = FALSE
)

pred_bb_m1<- pred_grid_wi %>%
  select(ubigeo, year, id.sp, id.time) %>%
  mutate(
    model = "m1",
    mean = fit_bb_m1$summary.fitted.values$mean[pred_idx_wi],
    median = fit_bb_m1$summary.fitted.values$`0.5quant`[pred_idx_wi],
    lower = fit_bb_m1$summary.fitted.values$`0.025quant`[pred_idx_wi],
    upper = fit_bb_m1$summary.fitted.values$`0.975quant`[pred_idx_wi],
    sd = fit_bb_m1$summary.fitted.values$sd[pred_idx_wi],
    ci_width = upper - lower
  )
```

# Summary

```{r}
model_labels<- c("m1", "m2", "m3", "m4")

cpo_bb_m1<- -2 * sum(log(fit_bb_m1$cpo$cpo[1:n_obs_wi]), na.rm = TRUE)
cpo_bb_m2<- -2 * sum(log(fit_bb_m2$cpo$cpo[1:n_obs_wi]), na.rm = TRUE)
cpo_bb_m3<- -2 * sum(log(fit_bb_m3$cpo$cpo[1:n_obs_wi]), na.rm = TRUE)
cpo_bb_m4<- -2 * sum(log(fit_bb_m4$cpo$cpo[1:n_obs_wi]), na.rm = TRUE)

model_metrics_wi<- tibble(
  Modelo = model_labels,
  DIC = c(fit_bb_m1$dic$dic, fit_bb_m2$dic$dic,
          fit_bb_m3$dic$dic, fit_bb_m4$dic$dic),
  pD = c(fit_bb_m1$dic$p.eff, fit_bb_m2$dic$p.eff,
         fit_bb_m3$dic$p.eff, fit_bb_m4$dic$p.eff),
  WAIC = c(fit_bb_m1$waic$waic, fit_bb_m2$waic$waic,
           fit_bb_m3$waic$waic, fit_bb_m4$waic$waic),
  pWAIC = c(fit_bb_m1$waic$p.eff, fit_bb_m2$waic$p.eff,
            fit_bb_m3$waic$p.eff, fit_bb_m4$waic$p.eff),
  logML = c(fit_bb_m1$mlik[1,1], fit_bb_m2$mlik[1,1],
            fit_bb_m3$mlik[1,1], fit_bb_m4$mlik[1,1]),
  CPO = c(cpo_bb_m1, cpo_bb_m2, cpo_bb_m3, cpo_bb_m4)
)
```

## Summary table

```{r}
model_metrics_wi %>%
  arrange(Modelo) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**INLA model comparison — WI**")) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(DIC, pD, WAIC, pWAIC, logML, CPO), decimals = 2)
```

# Model accuracy

```{r}
pred_all_wi<- bind_rows(pred_bb_m1, pred_bb_m2,
                        pred_bb_m3, pred_bb_m4)

fitted_vals<- pred_all_wi %>%
  left_join(wi_censo_final, by = c("ubigeo", "year")) %>%
  rename(modelo = model, estimacion_real = hv270_recat, fit = mean)
```

```{r}
perform.metrics<- yardstick::metric_set(mae, mase, smape, rmse)

tbl.yrd.full<- fitted_vals %>%
  group_by(modelo) %>%
  perform.metrics(truth = estimacion_real, estimate = fit)

tbl.yrd.year<- fitted_vals %>%
  group_by(modelo, year) %>%
  perform.metrics(truth = estimacion_real, estimate = fit)
```

## Table in-sample accuracy metrics

```{r}
tbl.yrd.full %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = modelo, names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate) %>%
  arrange(modelo) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("in-sample accuracy metrics — WI"))
```

## Comparison DE vs Pred. SAE

```{r}
figura2_c<-
  fitted_vals %>%
  mutate(
    modelo = factor(modelo,
                    levels = c("m1","m2","m3","m4"),
                    labels = c("Mp-1","Mp-2","Mp-3","Mp-4"))
  ) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2010,2012,2014,2016,2018,2020)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimacion_real, y = median, color = modelo)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2, show.legend = F) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_color_lancet() +
  facet_grid(year~modelo) +
  labs(
    x = "Prop.% (Direct estimate)",
    y = "Prop.% (Predicted)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face ="bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Heatplot accuracy metrics by year

```{r}
graph_heatplot<-
  bind_rows(tbl.yrd.year, tbl.yrd.full) %>%
  mutate(
    year2 = ifelse(is.na(year),"T. model",year)
  ) %>%

  filter(
    .metric != "mase"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    labels = round(.estimate,3),
    legend_title = .metric,

    modelo = factor(modelo,
                    levels = c("m1","m2","m3","m4"),
                    labels = c("Mp-1","Mp-2","Mp-3","Mp-4"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(.metric) %>%
  filter(year2 %in% c("2010","2012","2014","2016","2018","2020","T. model")) %>%
  nest() %>%

  mutate(
    grafico = map(.x = data,
                  .f = ~ggplot(data = .x)+
                    geom_tile(aes(x = modelo, y = as.factor(year2), fill = .estimate), alpha = .8, show.legend = F) +
                    geom_text(aes(x = modelo, y = as.factor(year2),label =labels), size = 4) +
                    scale_fill_tw3("blue")+
                    labs(
                      fill = NULL,
                      y = NULL,
                      x = .x$legend_title
                    ) +

                    theme_minimal() +
                    scale_x_discrete(position = "top")+
                    theme(
                      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
                      axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
                      strip.text = element_text(face ="bold"),
                      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8)
                    )
    )
  )

figura2_d<- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = graph_heatplot$grafico, nrow = 1)
```

```{r}
figura2_parte2<- cowplot::plot_grid(figura2_c,figura2_d,

```

### MSE (bias + variance)

```{r, warning=FALSE}
mse_area<-
  fitted_vals %>%
  mutate(
    bias2 = (fit - estimacion_real)^2,
    variance = sd^2,
    mse = bias2 + variance
  )

mse_area_long<-
  mse_area %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mse, bias2, variance)) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("mse", "bias2", "variance"))) %>%
  mutate(
    modelo = factor(modelo,
                    levels = c("m1","m2","m3","m4"),
                    labels = c("Mp-1","Mp-2","Mp-3","Mp-4"))
  )

mse_area_year<-
  mse_area %>%
  group_by(modelo, year) %>%
  summarise(
    bias2 = mean(bias2, na.rm = TRUE),
    variance = mean(variance, na.rm = TRUE),
    mse = mean(mse, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mse, bias2, variance)) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("mse", "bias2", "variance")),

         modelo = factor(modelo,
                    levels = c("m1","m2","m3","m4"),
                    labels = c("Mp-1","Mp-2","Mp-3","Mp-4"))
  )

labelsfacet2<- c("mse" = "MSE", "bias2" = "Bias^2", "variance" = "Variance")

mse_wi<-
  ggplot(mse_area_long,
         aes(x = as.character(year), y = log(value), color = modelo, shape = modelo)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_point(data = mse_area_year,
             aes(x = as.character(year), y = log(value)),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_lancet() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = rep(c(16,17,15,18,8,3), length.out = 5)) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(2010, 2020, by = 2)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "log(value)", color = "Model", shape = "Model") +
  facet_wrap(~name, labeller = labeller(name = labelsfacet2, .default = label_parsed)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom")

mse_wi
```

mse_edu,

)

### Cross validation (leave-one-district-out)

```{r}
cv_formulas_wi<- list(m1 = formula_bb_m1, m2 = formula_bb_m2,
                      m3 = formula_bb_m3, m4 = formula_bb_m4)

loo_wi<- imap_dfr(cv_formulas_wi, ~ loo_district_cv(
  formula = .x,
  label = .y,
  data = inla_data_wi,
  obs_idx = 1:n_obs_wi,
  pred_idx = pred_idx_wi,
  obs_ubigeo = cluster_wi_pca$ubigeo,
  pred_grid = pred_grid_pca,
  family = "betabinomial",
  control.family = prior_bb_rho,
  control.inla = ctrl_inla_wi
))

loo_eval_wi<- loo_wi %>%
  inner_join(wi_censo_final %>% select(ubigeo, year, direct = hv270_recat),
             by = c("ubigeo", "year"))
```

```{r}
loo.metrics<- yardstick::metric_set(mae, smape, rmse)

loo_eval_wi %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  loo.metrics(truth = direct, estimate = mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = model, names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Leave-one-district-out accuracy**")) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(mae, smape, rmse), decimals = 4)
```

```{r}
sup2b_heat_data<-
  bind_rows(tbl.yrd.year, tbl.yrd.full) %>%
  mutate(year2 = ifelse(is.na(year), "T. model", year)) %>%
  filter(.metric != "mase") %>%
  mutate(
    labels = round(.estimate, 3),
    legend_title = .metric,
    modelo = factor(modelo, levels = c("m1","m2","m3","m4"),
                    labels = c("Mp-1","Mp-2","Mp-3","Mp-4"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(.metric) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(grafico = map(.x = data, .f = ~ggplot(.x) +
    geom_tile(aes(x = modelo, y = as.factor(year2), fill = .estimate), alpha = .8, show.legend = F) +
    geom_text(aes(x = modelo, y = as.factor(year2), label = labels), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_tw3("blue") +
    labs(fill = NULL, y = NULL, x = .x$legend_title) +
    theme_minimal() + scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))))

cowplot::plot_grid(
  fitted_vals %>%
    mutate(modelo = factor(modelo, levels = c("m1","m2","m3","m4"),
                           labels = c("Mp-1","Mp-2","Mp-3","Mp-4"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = estimacion_real, y = median, color = modelo)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2, show.legend = F) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    scale_color_lancet() + facet_grid(year~modelo) +
    labs(x = "Prop.% (Direct estimate)", y = "Prop.% (Predicted)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")),
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = sup2b_heat_data$grafico, nrow = 1),
  cols = 1, rel_heights = c(.7, .3)
)

ggsave("./figures/sup_result_fig3.5.png", dpi = 300, bg = "white", width = 18, height = 12)
ggsave("./figures/sup_result_fig3.5.pdf", dpi = 300, bg = "white", width = 18, height = 12)
```

```{r}
direct_wi_all<- wi_edu %>%
  filter(!is.na(hv270_recat)) %>%
  group_by(ubigeo, year) %>%
  summarise(direct = weighted.mean(hv270_recat, hv005, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(pred_all_wi %>% filter(model == "m3" & year %in% c(2010:2013)),
       aes(x = median, y = ubigeo)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper, color = "Predicted value"),
                  linewidth = .6, alpha = .5) +
  geom_point(data = direct_wi_all %>% filter(year %in% c(2010:2013)),
             aes(x = direct, y = ubigeo, color = "Direct estimate"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = .5, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Predicted value" = "blue4", "Direct estimate" = "red4"), name = "") +
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  coord_flip()
ggsave("./figures/sup_result_fig3.2a.png", dpi = 300, bg = "white", width = 18, height = 12)
ggsave("./figures/sup_result_fig3.2a.pdf", dpi = 300, bg = "white", width = 18, height = 12)

```
